File: app/services/upload_service.py
================
 1: """File upload handling service."""
 2: import logging
 3: import os
 4: import uuid
 5: from flask import current_app
 6: from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename
 7: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 8: def validate_image(file) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
 9:     """Check that an uploaded file is a valid image.
10:     Args:
11:         file: Werkzeug ``FileStorage`` object.
12:     Returns:
13:         Tuple of (is_valid, error_message).
14:     """
15:     if file is None or file.filename == '':
16:         return (False, 'No file selected')
17:     ext = file.filename.rsplit('.', 1)[-1].lower() if '.' in file.filename else ''
18:     allowed = current_app.config.get('ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS', set())
19:     if ext not in allowed:
20:         return (False, f'File type not allowed. Allowed: {", ".join(allowed)}')
21:     # Check size by reading content length header (may not always be set)
22:     max_size = current_app.config.get('MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH', 5 * 1024 * 1024)
23:     file.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
24:     size = file.tell()
25:     file.seek(0)
26:     if size > max_size:
27:         return (False, f'File too large. Maximum size: {max_size // (1024 * 1024)} MB')
28:     return (True, None)
29: def save_uploaded_file(file, subfolder: str) -> str | None:
30:     """Save an uploaded image file to the uploads directory.
31:     Args:
32:         file: Werkzeug ``FileStorage`` object.
33:         subfolder: Subdirectory within the upload folder (e.g. ``'menu'``).
34:     Returns:
35:         Relative URL path to the saved file, or ``None`` on validation failure.
36:     """
37:     is_valid, error = validate_image(file)
38:     if not is_valid:
39:         logger.warning('Upload rejected: %s', error)
40:         return None
41:     original = secure_filename(file.filename)
42:     filename = f'{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original}'
43:     output_dir = os.path.join(
44:         current_app.config['UPLOAD_FOLDER'], subfolder
45:     )
46:     os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
47:     filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
48:     file.save(filepath)
49:     return f'/static/images/uploads/{subfolder}/{filename}'
50: def delete_file(file_path: str) -> bool:
51:     """Delete a file given its relative URL path.
52:     Args:
53:         file_path: Relative URL (e.g. ``/static/images/uploads/menu/img.png``).
54:     Returns:
55:         ``True`` if the file was deleted, ``False`` otherwise.
56:     """
57:     try:
58:         # Convert relative URL to absolute filesystem path
59:         # Strip leading /static/ to get path relative to app/static/
60:         relative = file_path.lstrip('/')
61:         if relative.startswith('static/'):
62:             relative = relative[len('static/'):]
63:         abs_path = os.path.join(
64:             current_app.root_path, 'static', relative
65:         )
66:         if os.path.exists(abs_path):
67:             os.remove(abs_path)
68:             return True
69:         logger.warning('File not found for deletion: %s', abs_path)
70:         return False
71:     except OSError:
72:         logger.exception('Failed to delete file: %s', file_path)
73:         return False

 5:  * Display a toast notification.

 9: function showToast(message, type = "info") {
10:   const colors = {
11:     success: "bg-green-500",
12:     error: "bg-red-500",
13:     warning: "bg-yellow-500 text-gray-900",
14:     info: "bg-blue-500",
15:   };
16:   const toast = document.createElement("div");
17:   toast.className = `fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm ${colors[type] || colors.info}`;
18:   toast.textContent = message;
19:   document.body.appendChild(toast);
20:   setTimeout(() => {
21:     toast.style.transition = "opacity 0.5s";
22:     toast.style.opacity = "0";
23:     setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 500);
24:   }, 4000);
25: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Tablii — Cart management using localStorage.
  3:  */
  4: class Cart {
  5:     /**
  6:      * @param {string} restaurantSlug
  7:      * @param {number} tableId
  8:      */
  9:     constructor(restaurantSlug, tableId) {
 10:         this.storageKey = `tablii_cart_${restaurantSlug}_${tableId}`;
 11:         this.items = [];
 12:         this.load();
 13:     }
 14:     /**
 15:      * Add an item to the cart.
 16:      * @param {Object} item - { id, name, price, quantity, options, image_url }
 17:      */
 18:     addItem(item) {
 19:         this.items.push({
 20:             id: item.id,
 21:             name: item.name,
 22:             price: item.price,
 23:             quantity: item.quantity || 1,
 24:             options: item.options || [],
 25:             image_url: item.image_url || ""
 26:         });
 27:         this.save();
 28:     }
 29:     /**
 30:      * Remove an item by index.
 31:      * @param {number} index
 32:      */
 33:     removeItem(index) {
 34:         this.items.splice(index, 1);
 35:         this.save();
 36:     }
 37:     /**
 38:      * Update quantity at index. Remove if quantity <= 0.
 39:      * @param {number} index
 40:      * @param {number} quantity
 41:      */
 42:     updateQuantity(index, quantity) {
 43:         if (quantity <= 0) {
 44:             this.removeItem(index);
 45:         } else {
 46:             this.items[index].quantity = Math.min(quantity, 20);
 47:             this.save();
 48:         }
 49:     }
 50:     /**
 51:      * Get all cart items.
 52:      * @returns {Array}
 53:      */
 54:     getItems() {
 55:         return this.items;
 56:     }
 57:     /**
 58:      * Calculate subtotal (price + option extras) * quantity for all items.
 59:      * @returns {number}
 60:      */
 61:     getSubtotal() {
 62:         return this.items.reduce((total, item) => {
 63:             const optExtra = (item.options || []).reduce((s, o) => s + (o.extra_price || 0), 0);
 64:             return total + (item.price + optExtra) * item.quantity;
 65:         }, 0);
 66:     }
 67:     /**
 68:      * Calculate tax amount.
 69:      * @param {number} taxRate - percentage (e.g. 7 for 7%)
 70:      * @returns {number}
 71:      */
 72:     getTax(taxRate) {
 73:         return this.getSubtotal() * (taxRate / 100);
 74:     }
 75:     /**
 76:      * Calculate service charge amount.
 77:      * @param {number} serviceChargeRate - percentage (e.g. 5 for 5%)
 78:      * @returns {number}
 79:      */
 80:     getServiceCharge(serviceChargeRate) {
 81:         return this.getSubtotal() * ((serviceChargeRate || 0) / 100);
 82:     }
 83:     /**
 84:      * Calculate total (subtotal + tax + service charge).
 85:      * @param {number} taxRate
 86:      * @param {number} serviceChargeRate
 87:      * @returns {number}
 88:      */
 89:     getTotal(taxRate, serviceChargeRate) {
 90:         return this.getSubtotal() + this.getTax(taxRate) + this.getServiceCharge(serviceChargeRate);
 91:     }
 92:     /**
 93:      * Get total item count.
 94:      * @returns {number}
 95:      */
 96:     getItemCount() {
 97:         return this.items.reduce((count, item) => count + item.quantity, 0);
 98:     }
 99:     /**
100:      * Empty the cart.
101:      */
102:     clear() {
103:         this.items = [];
104:         this.save();
105:     }
106:     /**
107:      * Save cart to localStorage.
108:      */
109:     save() {
110:         try {
111:             localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(this.items));
112:         } catch (e) {
113:             console.warn("Failed to save cart:", e);
114:         }
115:     }
116:     /**
117:      * Load cart from localStorage.
118:      */
119:     load() {
120:         try {
121:             const data = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
122:             this.items = data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
123:         } catch (e) {
124:             this.items = [];
125:         }
126:     }
127: }

  1: /**
  2:  * cashier_board.js — Live Kanban board logic for the cashier interface.
  3:  */
  4: const CSRF = document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content || '';
  5: let _newOrderSoundPlayed = false; // only play audio on WS events, not page load
  6: function parseServerDate(value) {
  7:     if (!value) return new Date();
  8:     const normalized = String(value).replace(' ', 'T').trim();
  9:     if (/[zZ]$|[+\-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(normalized)) {
 10:         return new Date(normalized);
 11:     }
 12:     return new Date(`${normalized}Z`);
 13: }
 14: function formatOrderNumber(value) {
 15:     const raw = String(value || '').trim();
 16:     if (!raw) return '#----';
 17:     return raw.startsWith('#') ? raw : `#${raw}`;
 18: }
 19: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20: // Timer helpers
 21: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22: /**
 23:  * Start updating an order-timer element every second.
 24:  * @param {HTMLElement} el  - Element with data-start ISO timestamp.
 25:  */
 26: function startCardTimer(el) {
 27:     function update() {
 28:         const start = parseServerDate(el.dataset.start);
 29:         if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime())) return;
 30:         const mins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - start.getTime()) / 60000));
 31:         el.textContent = `${mins}m`;
 32:         if (mins >= 20) {
 33:             el.className = 'order-timer text-xs text-red-500 font-semibold';
 34:         } else if (mins >= 10) {
 35:             el.className = 'order-timer text-xs text-yellow-500 font-semibold';
 36:         } else {
 37:             el.className = 'order-timer text-xs text-gray-400';
 38:         }
 39:     }
 40:     update();
 41:     if (el._timerInterval) clearInterval(el._timerInterval);
 42:     el._timerInterval = setInterval(update, 10000);
 43: }
 44: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 48:  * POST a status change; move card to new column on success.
 49:  * @param {number} id
 50:  * @param {string} status
 51:  */
 52: async function changeOrderStatus(id, status) {
 53:     try {
 54:         const res = await fetch(`/cashier/orders/${id}/status`, {
 55:             method: 'POST',
 56:             headers: {
 57:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 58:                 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF,
 59:             },
 60:             body: JSON.stringify({ new_status: status }),
 61:         });
 62:         const data = await res.json();
 63:         if (!data.success) {
 64:             alert(data.error || 'Could not update order.');
 65:             return;
 66:         }
 67:         if (status === 'cancelled') {
 68:             removeOrderCard(id);
 69:         } else {
 70:             moveOrderCard(id, status);
 71:         }
 72:     } catch (err) {
 73:         console.error('changeOrderStatus error:', err);
 74:     }
 75: }
 76: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 77: // DOM card manipulation
 78: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 79: const NEXT_STATUS = {
 80:     new: 'accepted',
 81:     accepted: 'preparing',
 82:     preparing: 'ready',
 83:     ready: 'served',
 84:     served: 'completed',
 85: };
 86: const NEXT_LABEL = {
 87:     accepted: 'Accept',
 88:     preparing: 'Prepare',
 89:     ready: 'Ready',
 90:     served: 'Served',
 91:     completed: 'Complete',
 92: };
 93: /**
 94:  * Animate the order card from its current column to newStatus column.
 95:  * @param {number} id
 96:  * @param {string} newStatus
 97:  */
 98: function moveOrderCard(id, newStatus) {
 99:     const card = document.getElementById(`order-card-${id}`);
100:     if (!card) return;
101:     const oldStatus = card.dataset.status;
102:     // Fade out
103:     card.classList.add('moving');
104:     setTimeout(() => {
105:         const targetCol = document.getElementById(`cards-${newStatus}`);
106:         if (!targetCol) {
107:             // Status not shown (e.g. 'served') — just remove
108:             card.remove();
109:             updateColumnCount(oldStatus);
110:         } else {
111:             card.classList.remove('moving');
112:             card.dataset.status = newStatus;
113:             // Update action buttons
114:             const next = NEXT_STATUS[newStatus];
115:             const nextLabel = NEXT_LABEL[next] || next;
116:             const advanceBtn = card.querySelector('button:first-of-type');
117:             if (advanceBtn && next) {
118:                 advanceBtn.textContent = `→ ${nextLabel}`;
119:                 advanceBtn.setAttribute('onclick', `changeOrderStatus(${id}, '${next}')`);
120:             } else if (advanceBtn) {
121:                 advanceBtn.remove();
122:             }
123:             // Hide cancel button for statuses that don't allow it
124:             const cancelBtn = card.querySelector('button:last-of-type');
125:             if (cancelBtn && cancelBtn.textContent.trim() === 'Cancel') {
126:                 if (!['new', 'accepted'].includes(newStatus)) {
127:                     cancelBtn.remove();
128:                 }
129:             }
130:             targetCol.appendChild(card);
131:             updateColumnCount(oldStatus);
132:             updateColumnCount(newStatus);
133:         }
134:     }, 280);
135: }

File: app/static/js/floor_map.js

  1: /**
  2:  * floor_map.js
  3:  * Interactive canvas-based floor map editor.
  4:  * Tables are rendered as colored draggable rectangles.
  5:  */
  6: 'use strict';
  7: // ── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  8: const TABLE_W = 80;
  9: const TABLE_H = 60;
 10: const STATUS_COLORS = {
 11:   free:      '#22c55e',  // green-500
 12:   occupied:  '#f97316',  // orange-500
 13:   reserved:  '#ef4444',  // red-500
 14: };
 15: // ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 16: let _canvas = null;
 17: let _ctx    = null;
 18: let _tables = [];   // [{id, table_number, status, x, y}, ...]
 19: let _drag = { active: false, tableIdx: -1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 };
 20: // ── 1. renderFloorMap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 21: /**
 22:  * Initialise and render the floor map on a canvas element.
 23:  *
 24:  * @param {string} canvasId - ID of the <canvas> element.
 25:  * @param {Array}  tables   - Array of table objects.
 26:  */
 27: function renderFloorMap(canvasId, tables) {
 28:   _canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
 29:   if (!_canvas) return;
 30:   _ctx = _canvas.getContext('2d');
 31:   _tables = tables.map((t, i) => ({
 32:     ...t,
 33:     x: t.pos_x ?? (30 + (i % 5) * 100),
 34:     y: t.pos_y ?? (30 + Math.floor(i / 5) * 90),
 35:   }));
 36:   _canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', _onMouseDown);
 37:   _canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', _onMouseMove);
 38:   _canvas.addEventListener('mouseup',   _onMouseUp);
 39:   _canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', _onMouseUp);
 40:   _draw();
 41: }
 42: // ── Drawing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 43: function _draw() {
 44:   _ctx.clearRect(0, 0, _canvas.width, _canvas.height);
 45:   // Grid background
 46:   _ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
 47:   _ctx.lineWidth = 1;
 48:   for (let x = 0; x <= _canvas.width; x += 40) {
 49:     _ctx.beginPath(); _ctx.moveTo(x, 0); _ctx.lineTo(x, _canvas.height); _ctx.stroke();
 50:   }
 51:   for (let y = 0; y <= _canvas.height; y += 40) {
 52:     _ctx.beginPath(); _ctx.moveTo(0, y); _ctx.lineTo(_canvas.width, y); _ctx.stroke();
 53:   }
 54:   _tables.forEach(t => {
 55:     const color = STATUS_COLORS[t.status] || STATUS_COLORS.free;
 56:     const radius = 10;
 57:     // Rounded rectangle
 58:     _ctx.beginPath();
 59:     _ctx.moveTo(t.x + radius, t.y);
 60:     _ctx.lineTo(t.x + TABLE_W - radius, t.y);
 61:     _ctx.arcTo(t.x + TABLE_W, t.y, t.x + TABLE_W, t.y + radius, radius);
 62:     _ctx.lineTo(t.x + TABLE_W, t.y + TABLE_H - radius);
 63:     _ctx.arcTo(t.x + TABLE_W, t.y + TABLE_H, t.x + TABLE_W - radius, t.y + TABLE_H, radius);
 64:     _ctx.lineTo(t.x + radius, t.y + TABLE_H);
 65:     _ctx.arcTo(t.x, t.y + TABLE_H, t.x, t.y + TABLE_H - radius, radius);
 66:     _ctx.lineTo(t.x, t.y + radius);
 67:     _ctx.arcTo(t.x, t.y, t.x + radius, t.y, radius);
 68:     _ctx.closePath();
 69:     _ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';    // 20% opacity fill
 70:     _ctx.fill();
 71:     _ctx.strokeStyle = color;
 72:     _ctx.lineWidth = 2;
 73:     _ctx.stroke();
 74:     // Table number label
 75:     _ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
 76:     _ctx.font = 'bold 14px Inter, sans-serif';
 77:     _ctx.textAlign = 'center';
 78:     _ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
 79:     _ctx.fillText(`T${t.table_number}`, t.x + TABLE_W / 2, t.y + TABLE_H / 2);
 80:     // Status dot
 81:     _ctx.beginPath();
 82:     _ctx.arc(t.x + TABLE_W - 10, t.y + 10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 83:     _ctx.fillStyle = color;
 84:     _ctx.fill();
 85:   });
 86: }
 87: // ── 2. dragTable ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 88: /**
 89:  * Update a table's position (called internally during mouse move).
 90:  */
 91: function dragTable(tableId, newX, newY) {
 92:   const t = _tables.find(t => t.id === tableId);
 93:   if (!t) return;
 94:   t.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, _canvas.width  - TABLE_W));
 95:   t.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, _canvas.height - TABLE_H));
 96:   _draw();
 97: }
 98: // ── 3. saveFloorLayout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 99: /**
100:  * POST the current table positions to the server.
101:  *
102:  * @param {string} url - Endpoint URL (default: /dashboard/tables/layout).
103:  */
104: async function saveFloorLayout(url = '/dashboard/tables/layout') {
105:   const positions = _tables.map(t => ({ id: t.id, pos_x: t.x, pos_y: t.y }));
106:   const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
107:   try {
108:     const res = await fetch(url, {
109:       method: 'POST',
110:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken },
111:       body: JSON.stringify({ positions }),
112:     });
113:     const data = await res.json();
114:     if (!data.success) console.warn('saveFloorLayout: server returned failure');
115:   } catch (err) {
116:     console.error('saveFloorLayout error:', err);
117:   }
118: }
119: // ── Mouse event handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
120: function _getMousePos(e) {
121:   const rect = _canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
122:   return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
123: }
124: function _hitTest(pos) {
125:   return _tables.findIndex(t =>
126:     pos.x >= t.x && pos.x <= t.x + TABLE_W &&
127:     pos.y >= t.y && pos.y <= t.y + TABLE_H
128:   );
129: }
130: function _onMouseDown(e) {
131:   const pos = _getMousePos(e);
132:   const idx = _hitTest(pos);
133:   if (idx >= 0) {
134:     _drag = {
135:       active: true,
136:       tableIdx: idx,
137:       offsetX: pos.x - _tables[idx].x,
138:       offsetY: pos.y - _tables[idx].y,
139:     };
140:     _canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
141:   }
142: }
143: function _onMouseMove(e) {
144:   const pos = _getMousePos(e);
145:   if (_drag.active) {
146:     const t = _tables[_drag.tableIdx];
147:     dragTable(t.id, pos.x - _drag.offsetX, pos.y - _drag.offsetY);
148:   } else {
149:     _canvas.style.cursor = _hitTest(pos) >= 0 ? 'grab' : 'default';
150:   }
151: }
152: function _onMouseUp() {
153:   if (_drag.active) {
154:     _drag.active = false;
155:     _canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
156:     saveFloorLayout();
157:   }
158: }

  1: /**
  2:  * kitchen_display.js — Timer logic and status updates for the kitchen screen.
  3:  */
  4: const CSRF = document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content || '';
  5: function parseServerDate(value) {
  6:     if (!value) return new Date();
  7:     const normalized = String(value).replace(' ', 'T').trim();
  8:     if (/[zZ]$|[+\-]\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(normalized)) {
  9:         return new Date(normalized);
 10:     }
 11:     return new Date(`${normalized}Z`);
 12: }
 13: function formatOrderNumber(value) {
 14:     const raw = String(value || '').trim();
 15:     if (!raw) return '#----';
 16:     return raw.startsWith('#') ? raw : `#${raw}`;
 17: }
 18: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19: // Timers
 20: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21: /**
 22:  * Start a live timer on a kitchen-timer element.
 23:  * Colors: normal → yellow after 10 min → red after 20 min.
 24:  * @param {HTMLElement} el - Element with data-start ISO timestamp.
 25:  */
 26: function startTimer(el) {
 27:     function update() {
 28:         const start = parseServerDate(el.dataset.start);
 29:         if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime())) return;
 30:         const totalSecs = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - start.getTime()) / 1000));
 31:         const mins = Math.floor(totalSecs / 60);
 32:         const secs = totalSecs % 60;
 33:         el.textContent = `${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 34:         el.className = 'kitchen-timer text-sm font-mono ';
 35:         if (mins >= 20) {
 36:             el.className += 'timer-urgent';
 37:         } else if (mins >= 10) {
 38:             el.className += 'timer-warn';
 39:         } else {
 40:             el.className += 'timer-normal';
 41:         }
 42:     }
 43:     update();
 44:     if (el._timerInterval) clearInterval(el._timerInterval);
 45:     el._timerInterval = setInterval(update, 1000);
 46: }
 47: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 48: // Status actions

File: app/static/js/menu_builder.js

  1: /**
  2:  * menu_builder.js
  3:  * Dashboard: drag-and-drop category/item reordering, image preview, toggle.
  4:  */
  5: 'use strict';
  6: // ── 1. initDragDropCategories ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  7: /**
  8:  * Enable drag-and-drop reordering of category rows.
  9:  * Expects rows with data-cat-id attribute inside a container.
 10:  *
 11:  * @param {string} containerId - ID of the <tbody> or list container.
 12:  * @param {string} reorderUrl  - POST URL for /dashboard/menu/categories/reorder.
 13:  */
 14: function initDragDropCategories(containerId = 'category-list', reorderUrl = '/dashboard/menu/categories/reorder') {
 15:   const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
 16:   if (!container) return;
 17:   let dragSrc = null;
 18:   container.querySelectorAll('[data-cat-id]').forEach(row => {
 19:     row.draggable = true;
 20:     row.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
 21:       dragSrc = row;
 22:       row.classList.add('opacity-50');
 23:       e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
 24:     });
 25:     row.addEventListener('dragend', () => row.classList.remove('opacity-50'));
 26:     row.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
 27:       e.preventDefault();
 28:       e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
 29:     });
 30:     row.addEventListener('drop', e => {
 31:       e.preventDefault();
 32:       if (dragSrc && dragSrc !== row) {
 33:         // Swap DOM positions
 34:         const allRows = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-cat-id]')];
 35:         const srcIdx = allRows.indexOf(dragSrc);
 36:         const dstIdx = allRows.indexOf(row);
 37:         if (srcIdx < dstIdx) {
 38:           container.insertBefore(dragSrc, row.nextSibling);
 39:         } else {
 40:           container.insertBefore(dragSrc, row);
 41:         }
 42:         _saveCategoryOrder(reorderUrl, container);
 43:       }
 44:     });
 45:   });
 46: }

 61: // ── 2. initDragDropItems ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
 62: /**
 63:  * Enable drag-and-drop reordering of menu item rows.
 64:  *
 65:  * @param {string} containerId - ID of the items container.
 66:  * @param {string} reorderUrl  - POST URL for /dashboard/menu/items/reorder.
 67:  */
 68: function initDragDropItems(containerId = 'item-list', reorderUrl = '/dashboard/menu/items/reorder') {
 69:   const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
 70:   if (!container) return;
 71:   let dragSrc = null;
 72:   container.querySelectorAll('[data-item-id]').forEach(row => {
 73:     row.draggable = true;
 74:     row.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
 75:       dragSrc = row;
 76:       row.classList.add('opacity-50');
 77:       e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
 78:     });
 79:     row.addEventListener('dragend', () => row.classList.remove('opacity-50'));
 80:     row.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
 81:       e.preventDefault();
 82:       e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
 83:     });
 84:     row.addEventListener('drop', e => {
 85:       e.preventDefault();
 86:       if (dragSrc && dragSrc !== row) {
 87:         const allRows = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-item-id]')];
 88:         const srcIdx = allRows.indexOf(dragSrc);
 89:         const dstIdx = allRows.indexOf(row);
 90:         if (srcIdx < dstIdx) {
 91:           container.insertBefore(dragSrc, row.nextSibling);
 92:         } else {
 93:           container.insertBefore(dragSrc, row);
 94:         }
 95:         _saveItemOrder(reorderUrl, container);
 96:       }
 97:     });
 98:   });
 99: }
100: async function _saveItemOrder(url, container) {

102:   const order = rows.map((r, i) => ({ id: parseInt(r.dataset.itemId), sort_order: i }));
103:   const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
104:   try {
105:     await fetch(url, {
106:       method: 'POST',
107:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken },
108:       body: JSON.stringify({ order }),
109:     });
110:   } catch (err) {
111:     console.error('Item reorder failed:', err);
112:   }
113: }
114: // ── 3. initImagePreview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
115: /**
116:  * Wire up an image file input to show a live preview.
117:  *
118:  * @param {string} inputId   - ID of the <input type="file"> element.
119:  * @param {string} previewId - ID of the <img> element to update.
120:  */
121: function initImagePreview(inputId = 'image-input', previewId = 'image-preview') {
122:   const input   = document.getElementById(inputId);
123:   const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
124:   if (!input || !preview) return;
125:   input.addEventListener('change', () => {
126:     const file = input.files[0];
127:     if (!file) return;
128:     if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
129:     const reader = new FileReader();
130:     reader.onload = e => {
131:       preview.src = e.target.result;
132:       preview.classList.remove('hidden');
133:     };
134:     reader.readAsDataURL(file);
135:   });
136: }
137: // ── 4. toggleAvailability ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
138: /**
139:  * Toggle a menu item's availability via AJAX without page reload.
140:  *
141:  * @param {number} itemId   - Menu item ID.
142:  * @param {Element} toggle  - The toggle switch element to update visually.
143:  */
144: async function toggleAvailability(itemId, toggle) {
145:   const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
146:   try {
147:     const res = await fetch(`/dashboard/menu/item/${itemId}/toggle`, {
148:       method: 'POST',
149:       headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken },
150:     });
151:     const data = await res.json();
152:     if (data.success) {
153:       // Visually flip the toggle
154:       if (toggle) {
155:         toggle.checked = data.is_available;
156:         const label = toggle.closest('label') || toggle.parentElement;
157:         if (label) {
158:           label.classList.toggle('bg-green-500', data.is_available);
159:           label.classList.toggle('bg-gray-300', !data.is_available);
160:         }
161:       }
162:     }
163:   } catch (err) {
164:     console.error('toggleAvailability error:', err);
165:   }
166: }

 6: 'use strict';
 7: // ── 1. requestNotificationPermission ──────────────────────────────────────
 8: /**
 9:  * Prompt the user for browser notification permission.
10:  * Only asks if permission is in the default (undecided) state.
11:  */
12: function requestNotificationPermission() {
13:   if (!('Notification' in window)) return;
14:   if (Notification.permission === 'default') {
15:     Notification.requestPermission().catch(() => {
16:       // Permission prompt suppressed or failed — silently ignore.
17:     });
18:   }
19: }
20: // ── 2. showDesktopNotification ─────────────────────────────────────────────
21: /**
22:  * Display a desktop notification if permission is granted.
23:  *
24:  * @param {string} title - Notification headline.
25:  * @param {string} body  - Notification body text.
26:  * @param {string} icon  - URL of the icon image.
27:  * @returns {Notification|null}
28:  */
29: function showDesktopNotification(
30:   title,
31:   body,
32:   icon = '/static/images/logo.png',
33: ) {
34:   if (!('Notification' in window)) return null;
35:   if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') return null;
36:   return new Notification(title, { body, icon });
37: }
38: // ── 3. vibratePhone ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
39: /**
40:  * Trigger haptic vibration on supported devices.
41:  *
42:  * @param {number|number[]} pattern - Vibration pattern in ms.
43:  */
44: function vibratePhone(pattern = [200]) {
45:   if ('vibrate' in navigator) {
46:     navigator.vibrate(pattern);
47:   }
48: }

 6: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 8: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

10: function _getSocket() {
11:     if (!socket) {

14:             console.debug('[Tablii] Socket connected:', socket.id);

16:         socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => {

18:         });
19:         socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {

21:         });
22:     }
23:     return socket;
24: }

 24: // ── 1. callWaiter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 25: /**
 26:  * Send a waiter call request from the customer page.
 27:  *
 28:  * @param {string} slug     - Restaurant slug.
 29:  * @param {number} tableId  - Table ID.
 30:  * @param {string} type     - Call type: 'water' | 'bill' | 'help' | 'custom'.
 31:  * @param {string} message  - Optional custom message.
 32:  */
 33: async function callWaiter(slug, tableId, type, message = '') {
 34:   const url = `/r/${slug}/table/${tableId}/call-waiter`;
 35:   try {
 36:     const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
 37:     const res = await fetch(url, {
 38:       method: 'POST',
 39:       headers: {
 40:         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 41:         'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
 42:       },
 43:       body: JSON.stringify({ call_type: type, message }),
 44:     });
 45:     const data = await res.json();
 46:     if (data.success) {
 47:       _showToast('Waiter has been called ✓');
 48:     } else {
 49:       _showToast(data.error || 'Failed to call waiter', 'error');
 50:     }
 51:     return data;
 52:   } catch (err) {

 54:     _showToast('Network error — please try again.', 'error');
 55:   }
 56: }

 60:   bill:   '💳',
 61:   help:   '🆘',
 62:   custom: '📝',

 64: /**
 65:  * Display an incoming waiter call as a banner (waiter-side).

 69: function showWaiterCall(data) {

 78:     'fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 max-w-xs w-full',
 79:     'bg-orange-500 text-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl p-4',

 81:   ].join(' ');
 82:   banner.innerHTML = `
 83:     <span class="text-2xl">${icon}</span>
 84:     <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
 85:       <p class="font-bold text-sm">Table ${data.table_number || data.table_id}</p>
 86:       <p class="text-xs capitalize">${(data.call_type || '').replace('_', ' ')}${data.message ? ' — ' + data.message : ''}</p>

File: app/static/sw.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * sw.js — Tablii Service Worker
 3:  *
 4:  * Strategy: cache-first for static assets, network-first for everything else.
 5:  * NEVER caches API or dynamic Flask routes.
 6:  */
 7: 'use strict';
 8: const CACHE_NAME = 'tablii-v1';
 9: // Only static, immutable assets — NO Flask routes, NO /dashboard, NO /r/ paths
10: const STATIC_ASSETS = [
11:   '/static/css/output.css',
12:   '/static/js/app.js',
13:   '/static/js/socket.js',
14:   '/static/js/cart.js',
15:   '/static/js/order_tracking.js',
16:   '/static/js/waiter_calls.js',
17:   '/static/js/notifications.js',
18:   '/static/images/logo.png',
19:   '/static/images/default_food.png',
20:   '/static/icons/icon-192.png',
21:   '/static/icons/icon-512.png',
22:   '/static/manifest.json',
23: ];
24: // ── Install ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
25: self.addEventListener('install', event => {
26:   event.waitUntil(
27:     caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => {
28:       // Use individual adds so one failure doesn't block everything
29:       return Promise.allSettled(
30:         STATIC_ASSETS.map(url => cache.add(url).catch(() => {/* log silently */}))
31:       );
32:     })
33:   );
34:   self.skipWaiting();
35: });
36: // ── Activate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37: self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
38:   event.waitUntil(
39:     caches.keys().then(names =>
40:       Promise.all(
41:         names
42:           .filter(name => name !== CACHE_NAME)
43:           .map(name => caches.delete(name))
44:       )
45:     )
46:   );
47:   self.clients.claim();
48: });
49: // ── Fetch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
50: self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
51:   const url = new URL(event.request.url);
52:   // Only handle same-origin GET requests
53:   if (event.request.method !== 'GET' || url.origin !== location.origin) {
54:     return;  // Let browser handle POST / cross-origin as normal
55:   }
56:   // Skip dynamic routes — let Flask SSR them fresh every time
57:   const isDynamic =
58:     url.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard') ||
59:     url.pathname.startsWith('/r/') ||
60:     url.pathname.startsWith('/cashier') ||
61:     url.pathname.startsWith('/kitchen') ||
62:     url.pathname.startsWith('/waiter') ||
63:     url.pathname.startsWith('/login') ||
64:     url.pathname.startsWith('/register') ||
65:     url.pathname.startsWith('/payment') ||
66:     url.pathname === '/';
67:   if (isDynamic) {
68:     return;  // Network only for all Flask-rendered pages
69:   }
70:   // Cache-first for static assets
71:   event.respondWith(
72:     caches.match(event.request).then(cached => {
73:       if (cached) return cached;
74:       return fetch(event.request).then(response => {
75:         if (response && response.status === 200) {
76:           const clone = response.clone();
77:           caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put(event.request, clone));
78:         }
79:         return response;
80:       });
81:     })
82:   );
83: });

68:       const themeIcon = document.getElementById('theme-icon');
69:       const htmlElement = document.documentElement;
70:       // Load theme from localStorage
71:       function initTheme() {
72:         const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('tablii-admin-theme') || 'light';
73:         if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
74:           htmlElement.classList.add('dark-mode');
75:           themeIcon.textContent = '☀️';
76:         } else {
77:           htmlElement.classList.remove('dark-mode');
78:           themeIcon.textContent = '🌙';
79:         }
80:       }
81:       // Toggle theme
82:       themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
83:         const isDarkMode = htmlElement.classList.contains('dark-mode');
84:         if (isDarkMode) {
85:           htmlElement.classList.remove('dark-mode');
86:           localStorage.setItem('tablii-admin-theme', 'light');
87:           themeIcon.textContent = '🌙';
88:         } else {
89:           htmlElement.classList.add('dark-mode');
90:           localStorage.setItem('tablii-admin-theme', 'dark');
91:           themeIcon.textContent = '☀️';
92:         }
93:       });
94:       // Initialize theme on page load
95:       initTheme();
96:     </script>
97:   </body>

85:       body: formData

87:     if (response.ok) {

90:     } else {
91:       document.getElementById('profile-btn-text').textContent = 'Save Changes';

126: <script>
127: function openEditModal(subId, plan, maxTables, maxItems, expiresAt) {
128:   document.getElementById('edit-form').action = `/admin/subscriptions/${subId}/update`;
129:   document.getElementById('edit-plan').value = plan;
130:   document.getElementById('edit-max-tables').value = maxTables;
131:   document.getElementById('edit-max-items').value = maxItems;
132:   document.getElementById('edit-expires').value = expiresAt;
133:   const modal = document.getElementById('edit-modal');
134:   modal.style.display = 'flex';
135:   modal.showModal?.();
136:   document.getElementById('edit-plan').focus();
137: }
138: function closeEditModal() {
139:   const modal = document.getElementById('edit-modal');
140:   modal.style.display = 'none';
141:   modal.close?.();
142: }
143: document.getElementById('edit-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
144:   if (e.target === this) closeEditModal();
145: });
146: document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
147:   if (e.key === 'Escape') closeEditModal();
148: });
149: var form = document.getElementById('edit-form');
150: form.onsubmit = async function(e) {
151:   e.preventDefault();
152:   var submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
153:   var originalText = submitBtn.textContent;
154:   submitBtn.disabled = true;
155:   submitBtn.style.opacity = '0.6';
156:   document.getElementById('save-btn-text').textContent = 'Saving...';
157:   var data = new FormData(form);
158:   var response = await fetch(form.action, {
159:     method: 'POST',
160:     body: data
161:   });
162:   if (response.ok) {
163:     document.getElementById('save-btn-text').textContent = 'Saved ✓';
164:     setTimeout(() => { window.location.reload(); }, 500);
165:   } else {
166:     document.getElementById('save-btn-text').textContent = originalText;
167:     submitBtn.disabled = false;
168:     submitBtn.style.opacity = '1';
169:     alert('Error saving subscription');
170:   }
171: };
172: </script>
173: {% endblock %}

124:   function switchTab(type) {
125:     const isOwner = type === 'owner';
126:     const formOwner = document.getElementById('form-owner');
127:     const formStaff = document.getElementById('form-staff');
128:     // Add subtle animation when switching
129:     if(isOwner) {
130:       formOwner.classList.remove('hidden');
131:       formStaff.classList.add('hidden');
132:     } else {
133:       formStaff.classList.remove('hidden');
134:       formOwner.classList.add('hidden');
135:     }
136:     const active   = 'text-amber-400 border-b-2 border-amber-500 bg-charcoal-800/20';
137:     const inactive = 'text-charcoal-500 hover:text-cream-100 hover:bg-charcoal-800/10 border-b-2 border-transparent';
138:     const tabOwner = document.getElementById('tab-owner');
139:     const tabStaff = document.getElementById('tab-staff');
140:     tabOwner.className = 'tab-btn flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300 mb-[-1px] ' + (isOwner ? active : inactive);
141:     tabStaff.className = 'tab-btn flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300 mb-[-1px] ' + (!isOwner ? active : inactive);
142:   }
143:   switchTab("{{ login_type or 'owner' }}");
144: </script>
145: {% endblock %}

116: {% block scripts %}
117: <script>
118: const activeClasses = ['bg-amber-600/10', 'text-amber-500', 'border-amber-500/50', 'shadow-inner-glow'];
119: const inactiveClasses = ['bg-charcoal-800/30', 'text-charcoal-400', 'border-charcoal-700/50'];
120: const searchField = document.getElementById('item-search');
121: const emptyState = document.getElementById('items-empty-state');
122: let activeCategory = 'all';
123: function sanitizeQty(value) {
124:     const parsed = parseInt(value, 10);
125:     if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
126:         return 0;
127:     }
128:     return Math.min(20, Math.max(0, parsed));
129: }
130: function updateTotal() {
131:     const total = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.item-card')).reduce((sum, card) => {
132:         const qtyInput = card.querySelector('.qty-input');
133:         const qty = sanitizeQty(qtyInput.value);
134:         qtyInput.value = qty;
135:         return sum + (qty * parseFloat(card.dataset.price || '0'));
136:     }, 0);
137:     document.getElementById('running-total').textContent = total.toFixed(3);
138: }
139: function setQty(id, nextQty) {
140:     const input = document.getElementById(`qty-${id}`);
141:     input.value = sanitizeQty(nextQty);
142:     updateTotal();
143: }
144: function incQty(id) {
145:     const input = document.getElementById(`qty-${id}`);
146:     setQty(id, sanitizeQty(input.value) + 1);
147: }
148: function decQty(id) {
149:     const input = document.getElementById(`qty-${id}`);
150:     setQty(id, sanitizeQty(input.value) - 1);
151: }
152: function clearOrder() {
153:     document.querySelectorAll('.qty-input').forEach(input => {
154:         input.value = 0;
155:     });
156:     document.querySelectorAll('textarea[name^="notes_"]').forEach(field => {
157:         field.value = '';
158:     });
159:     updateTotal();
160: }
161: function setActiveCategoryTab() {
162:     document.querySelectorAll('.cat-tab').forEach(btn => {
163:         const isActive = btn.dataset.cat === activeCategory;
164:         btn.classList.remove(...(isActive ? inactiveClasses : activeClasses));
165:         btn.classList.add(...(isActive ? activeClasses : inactiveClasses));
166:     });
167: }
168: function applyItemFilters() {
169:     const query = searchField.value.trim().toLowerCase();
170:     let visibleCount = 0;
171:     document.querySelectorAll('.item-card').forEach(card => {
172:         const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || card.dataset.cat === activeCategory;
173:         const matchesSearch = !query || (card.dataset.name || '').includes(query);
174:         const shouldShow = matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
175:         card.style.display = shouldShow ? '' : 'none';
176:         if (shouldShow) {
177:             visibleCount += 1;
178:         }
179:     });
180:     emptyState.classList.toggle('hidden', visibleCount > 0);
181: }
182: function filterCategory(catId, button = null) {
183:     activeCategory = catId;
184:     setActiveCategoryTab();
185:     applyItemFilters();
186: }
187: document.querySelectorAll('.qty-input').forEach(input => {
188:     input.addEventListener('input', () => {
189:         input.value = sanitizeQty(input.value);
190:         updateTotal();
191:     });
192: });

196: updateTotal();

 38:             <span>{{ t('total', lang) }}</span>

 42: </section>
 43: {% endblock %}
 44: {% block bottom_bar %}
 45: <a href="{{ url_for('customer.menu', slug=restaurant.slug, table_id=table.id) }}" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-orange-500 text-sm font-medium">
 46:     {{ t('back_to_menu', lang) }}
 47: </a>
 48: <a href="{{ url_for('customer.checkout', slug=restaurant.slug, table_id=table.id) }}" id="checkout-btn" class="btn-primary">
 49:     {{ t('checkout', lang) }}
 50: </a>
 51: {% endblock %}
 52: {% block scripts %}
 53: <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/cart.js') }}"></script>
 54: <script>
 55:     const cart = new Cart("{{ restaurant.slug }}", {{ table.id }});
 56:     const currency = "{{ restaurant.currency }}";
 57:     const taxRate = {{ restaurant.tax_rate }};
 58:     const serviceChargeRate = {{ restaurant.service_charge or 0 }};
 59:     function renderCart() {
 60:         const items = cart.getItems();
 61:         const container = document.getElementById("cart-items");
 62:         const emptyState = document.getElementById("cart-empty");
 63:         const summary = document.getElementById("cart-summary");
 64:         const notesSection = document.getElementById("cart-notes-section");
 65:         const checkoutBtn = document.getElementById("checkout-btn");
 66:         if (items.length === 0) {
 67:             emptyState.classList.remove("hidden");
 68:             container.innerHTML = "";
 69:             summary.classList.add("hidden");
 70:             notesSection.classList.add("hidden");
 71:             checkoutBtn.classList.add("hidden");
 72:             return;
 73:         }
 74:         emptyState.classList.add("hidden");
 75:         summary.classList.remove("hidden");
 76:         notesSection.classList.remove("hidden");
 77:         checkoutBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
 78:         let html = "";
 79:         items.forEach((item, idx) => {
 80:             const optExtra = item.options.reduce((s, o) => s + o.extra_price, 0);
 81:             const lineTotal = (item.price + optExtra) * item.quantity;
 82:             html += `
 83:                 <div class="card flex gap-3">
 84:                     ${item.image_url ? `<img src="${item.image_url}" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0">` : `<div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shrink-0">🍽️</div>`}
 85:                     <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
 86:                         <h3 class="font-medium text-sm truncate">${item.name}</h3>
 87:                         ${item.options.length ? `<p class="text-xs text-gray-400">${item.options.map(o => o.name || '').filter(n => n).join(", ")}</p>` : ""}
 88:                         <div class="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
 89:                             <div class="flex items-center border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
 90:                                 <button onclick="updateQty(${idx}, -1)" class="px-2 py-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-orange-500">−</button>
 91:                                 <span class="px-2 text-sm font-semibold">${item.quantity}</span>
 92:                                 <button onclick="updateQty(${idx}, 1)" class="px-2 py-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-orange-500">+</button>
 93:                             </div>
 94:                             <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-orange-600">${lineTotal.toFixed(3)} ${currency}</span>
 95:                         </div>
 96:                     </div>
 97:                     <button onclick="removeItem(${idx})" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 self-start text-lg">✕</button>
 98:                 </div>
 99:             `;
100:         });
101:         container.innerHTML = html;
102:         // Update summary
103:         const subtotal = cart.getSubtotal();
104:         const tax = cart.getTax(taxRate);
105:         const svcCharge = cart.getServiceCharge(serviceChargeRate);
106:         const total = cart.getTotal(taxRate, serviceChargeRate);
107:         document.getElementById("summary-subtotal").textContent = subtotal.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
108:         if (document.getElementById("summary-tax")) {
109:             document.getElementById("summary-tax").textContent = tax.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
110:         }
111:         if (document.getElementById("summary-service-charge")) {
112:             document.getElementById("summary-service-charge").textContent = svcCharge.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
113:         }
114:         document.getElementById("summary-total").textContent = total.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
115:     }
116:     function updateQty(idx, delta) {
117:         const items = cart.getItems();
118:         const newQty = items[idx].quantity + delta;
119:         if (newQty <= 0) {
120:             cart.removeItem(idx);
121:         } else {
122:             cart.updateQuantity(idx, newQty);
123:         }
124:         renderCart();
125:     }
126:     function removeItem(idx) {
127:         cart.removeItem(idx);
128:         renderCart();
129:     }
130:     renderCart();
131: </script>
132: {% endblock %}

 77: <script>
 78:     const cart = new Cart("{{ restaurant.slug }}", {{ table.id }});
 79:     const currency = "{{ restaurant.currency }}";
 80:     const taxRate = {{ restaurant.tax_rate }};
 81:     const serviceChargeRate = {{ restaurant.service_charge or 0 }};
 82:     const slug = "{{ restaurant.slug }}";
 83:     const tableId = {{ table.id }};
 84:     // Render checkout summary
 85:     function renderCheckout() {
 86:         const items = cart.getItems();
 87:         let html = "";
 88:         items.forEach(item => {
 89:             const optExtra = item.options.reduce((s, o) => s + o.extra_price, 0);
 90:             const lineTotal = (item.price + optExtra) * item.quantity;
 91:             html += `
 92:                 <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
 93:                     <span>${item.quantity}× ${item.name}</span>
 94:                     <span class="font-medium">${lineTotal.toFixed(3)} ${currency}</span>
 95:                 </div>
 96:             `;
 97:         });
 98:         document.getElementById("checkout-items").innerHTML = html;
 99:         const subtotal = cart.getSubtotal();
100:         const tax = cart.getTax(taxRate);
101:         const svcCharge = cart.getServiceCharge(serviceChargeRate);
102:         const total = cart.getTotal(taxRate, serviceChargeRate);
103:         document.getElementById("co-subtotal").textContent = subtotal.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
104:         if (document.getElementById("co-tax")) {
105:             document.getElementById("co-tax").textContent = tax.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
106:         }
107:         if (document.getElementById("co-service-charge")) {
108:             document.getElementById("co-service-charge").textContent = svcCharge.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
109:         }
110:         document.getElementById("co-total").textContent = total.toFixed(3) + " " + currency;
111:     }
112:     const _t = {
113:         placing_order: {{ t('placing_order', lang) | tojson }},
114:         order_placed: {{ t('order_placed', lang) | tojson }},
115:         confirm_order: {{ t('confirm_order', lang) | tojson }},
116:         select_table: {{ t('select_table', lang) | tojson }},
117:     };
118:     // Gift toggle
119:     function toggleGift(on) {
120:         document.getElementById('gift-section').classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
121:         if (on) loadOccupiedTables();
122:     }
123:     async function loadOccupiedTables() {
124:         const sel = document.getElementById('gift-table');
125:         sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">${_t.select_table}</option>`;
126:         try {
127:             const res = await fetch(`/r/${slug}/table/${tableId}/occupied-tables`);
128:             const data = await res.json();
129:             (data.tables || []).forEach(t => {
130:                 sel.innerHTML += `<option value="${t.id}">T-${t.table_number}</option>`;
131:             });
132:         } catch (_) {}
133:     }
134:     async function confirmOrder() {
135:         const btn = document.getElementById("confirm-order-btn");
136:         btn.disabled = true;
137:         btn.textContent = _t.placing_order;
138:         const items = cart.getItems().map(item => ({
139:             menu_item_id: item.id,
140:             quantity: item.quantity,
141:             selected_options: item.options.map(o => o.id),
142:             notes: ""
143:         }));
144:         const specialNotes = document.querySelector("#special-notes")?.value || "";
145:         const paymentMethod = document.querySelector('input[name="payment_method"]:checked')?.value || "cash";
146:         const body = { items, payment_method: paymentMethod, special_notes: specialNotes };
147:         const giftOn = document.getElementById('gift-toggle').checked;
148:         if (giftOn) {
149:             body.is_gift = true;
150:             body.gift_to_table = parseInt(document.getElementById('gift-table').value) || null;
151:             body.gift_message = document.getElementById('gift-message').value || '';
152:         }
153:         try {
154:             const res = await fetch(`/r/${slug}/table/${tableId}/order`, {
155:                 method: "POST",
156:                 headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
157:                 body: JSON.stringify(body)
158:             });
159:             const data = await res.json();
160:             if (data.success) {
161:                 cart.clear();
162:                 showToast(_t.order_placed + " " + data.order_number, "success");
163:                 window.location.href = `/r/${slug}/table/${tableId}/track/${data.order_id}`;
164:             } else {
165:                 showToast(data.error || "Failed to place order.", "error");
166:                 btn.disabled = false;
167:                 btn.textContent = _t.confirm_order;
168:             }
169:         } catch (err) {
170:             showToast("Network error. Please try again.", "error");
171:             btn.disabled = false;
172:             btn.textContent = _t.confirm_order;
173:         }
174:     }
175:     renderCheckout();
176: </script>
177: {% endblock %}

339:     function addFromModal(itemId) {

358:     function enforceMaxSelections(custId, maxSel) {
359:         if (!maxSel || maxSel <= 0) return;
360:         const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="cust_${custId}"]`);
361:         const checkedCount = document.querySelectorAll(`input[name="cust_${custId}"]:checked`).length;
362:         checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
363:             if (!cb.checked) {
364:                 const label = cb.closest('label');
365:                 if (checkedCount >= maxSel) {
366:                     cb.disabled = true;
367:                     label.classList.add('opacity-40', 'cursor-not-allowed');
368:                     label.classList.remove('cursor-pointer');
369:                 } else {
370:                     cb.disabled = false;
371:                     label.classList.remove('opacity-40', 'cursor-not-allowed');
372:                     label.classList.add('cursor-pointer');
373:                 }
374:             }
375:         });
376:     }
377:     const activeTabClasses = ['bg-amber-600/10', 'text-amber-500', 'border-amber-500/50', 'shadow-inner-glow'];
378:     const inactiveTabClasses = ['bg-charcoal-800/30', 'text-charcoal-400', 'border-charcoal-700/50'];
379:     const searchInput = document.getElementById('menu-search');
380:     const noResults = document.getElementById('menu-no-results');
381:     let activeCategory = 'all';
382:     function setActiveCategoryTab() {
383:         document.querySelectorAll('.category-tab').forEach(tab => {
384:             const isActive = tab.dataset.categoryTarget === activeCategory;
385:             tab.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
386:             tab.classList.remove(...(isActive ? inactiveTabClasses : activeTabClasses));
387:             tab.classList.add(...(isActive ? activeTabClasses : inactiveTabClasses));
388:         });
389:     }
390:     function applyMenuFilters() {
391:         const query = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
392:         const visibleCategories = new Set();
393:         document.querySelectorAll('.menu-category').forEach(section => {
394:             let visibleItems = 0;
395:             section.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card').forEach(card => {
396:                 const haystacks = [card.dataset.name || '', card.dataset.desc || ''];
397:                 const matchesSearch = !query || haystacks.some(value => value.includes(query));
398:                 card.style.display = matchesSearch ? '' : 'none';
399:                 if (matchesSearch) {
400:                     visibleItems += 1;
401:                 }
402:             });
403:             const hasVisibleItems = visibleItems > 0;
404:             const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || section.dataset.category === activeCategory;
405:             section.style.display = hasVisibleItems && matchesCategory ? 'block' : 'none';
406:             if (hasVisibleItems) {
407:                 visibleCategories.add(section.dataset.category);
408:             }
409:         });
410:         document.querySelectorAll('.category-tab').forEach(tab => {
411:             const target = tab.dataset.categoryTarget;
412:             if (target === 'all') {
413:                 tab.style.display = '';
414:                 tab.disabled = false;
415:                 return;
416:             }
417:             const shouldShowTab = !query || visibleCategories.has(target);
418:             tab.style.display = shouldShowTab ? '' : 'none';
419:             tab.disabled = !shouldShowTab;
420:         });
421:         const hasVisibleSection = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-category')).some(
422:             section => section.style.display !== 'none'
423:         );
424:         noResults.classList.toggle('hidden', hasVisibleSection);
425:     }
426:     function filterCategory(catId, button = null) {
427:         activeCategory = catId;
428:         setActiveCategoryTab();
429:         applyMenuFilters();
430:         if (button && activeCategory !== 'all') {
431:             const targetSection = document.querySelector(`.menu-category[data-category="${catId}"]`);
432:             if (targetSection && targetSection.style.display !== 'none') {
433:                 targetSection.classList.add('animate-fade-up');
434:                 setTimeout(() => targetSection.classList.remove('animate-fade-up'), 600);
435:             }
436:         }
437:     }
438:     searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
439:         activeCategory = 'all';
440:         setActiveCategoryTab();
441:         applyMenuFilters();
442:     });

64:             star.classList.toggle("text-yellow-400", parseInt(star.dataset.value) <= value);

66:         });

70:         if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
71:             const reader = new FileReader();
72:             reader.onload = e => {
73:                 preview.src = e.target.result;
74:                 preview.classList.remove("hidden");
75:             };

77:         }
78:     }

212: <script>
213: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
214:     initDragDropCategories('category-list');
215:     initImagePreview('add-icon-file', 'add-upload-img');
216:     // For the add icon placeholder
217:     document.getElementById('add-icon-file').addEventListener('change', function() {
218:         if (this.files && this.files[0]) {
219:             document.getElementById('add-upload-preview').classList.remove('hidden');
220:             document.getElementById('add-upload-placeholder').classList.add('hidden');
221:         }
222:     });
223:     initImagePreview('edit-icon-file', 'edit-upload-img');
224:     // For the edit icon placeholder
225:     document.getElementById('edit-icon-file').addEventListener('change', function() {
226:         if (this.files && this.files[0]) {
227:             document.getElementById('edit-upload-preview').classList.remove('hidden');
228:             document.getElementById('edit-upload-placeholder').classList.add('hidden');
229:         }
230:     });
231: });
232: function removeCurrentIcon() {
233:     document.getElementById('edit-current-icon').style.display = 'none';
234:     document.getElementById('edit-remove-icon').value = '1';
235: }
236: /* ── Edit Modal ── */
237: function openEditModalFromButton(btn) {
238:     openEditModal(
239:         parseInt(btn.dataset.id, 10),
240:         btn.dataset.nameFr || '',
241:         btn.dataset.nameAr || '',
242:         btn.dataset.nameEn || '',
243:         btn.dataset.iconUrl || '',
244:         btn.dataset.isActive === '1',
245:         btn.dataset.ramadanType || '',
246:         btn.dataset.availableFrom || '',
247:         btn.dataset.availableUntil || ''
248:     );
249: }
250: function openEditModal(id, nameFr, nameAr, nameEn, iconUrl, isActive, ramadanType, availableFrom, availableUntil) {
251:     document.getElementById('edit_name_fr').value = nameFr;
252:     document.getElementById('edit_name_ar').value = nameAr;
253:     document.getElementById('edit_name_en').value = nameEn;
254:     document.getElementById('edit_ramadan_type').value = ramadanType || '';
255:     document.getElementById('edit_is_active').checked = isActive;
256:     document.getElementById('edit_available_from').value = availableFrom || '';
257:     document.getElementById('edit_available_until').value = availableUntil || '';
258:     document.getElementById('edit-form').action = '/dashboard/menu/categories/' + id + '/update';
259:     document.getElementById('edit-remove-icon').value = '';
260:     // Show current icon if exists
261:     const currentIconDiv = document.getElementById('edit-current-icon');
262:     if (iconUrl) {
263:         document.getElementById('edit-current-icon-img').src = iconUrl;
264:         currentIconDiv.style.display = 'flex';
265:     } else {
266:         currentIconDiv.style.display = 'none';
267:     }
268:     // Reset upload preview
269:     document.getElementById('edit-upload-preview').classList.add('hidden');
270:     document.getElementById('edit-upload-placeholder').classList.remove('hidden');
271:     document.getElementById('edit-icon-file').value = '';
272:     document.getElementById('edit-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
273:     document.getElementById('edit-modal').classList.add('flex');
274: }
275: function closeEditModal() {
276:     document.getElementById('edit-modal').classList.add('hidden');
277:     document.getElementById('edit-modal').classList.remove('flex');
278: }
279: </script>
280: {% endblock %}

 77: <script>
 78: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
 79:     initDragDropItems('item-list');
 80: });
 81: async function toggleItem(id, btn) {
 82:     const csrfToken =
 83:         document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content ||
 84:         document.querySelector('input[name=csrf_token]')?.value ||
 85:         '';
 86:     const res = await fetch(`/dashboard/menu/item/${id}/toggle`, {
 87:         method: 'POST',
 88:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken },
 89:     });
 90:     const data = await res.json();
 91:     if (data.success) {
 92:         const label = data.is_available ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable';
 93:         const icon = data.is_available ? '●' : '○';
 94:         btn.textContent = icon + ' ' + label;
 95:         if (data.is_available) {
 96:             btn.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(197,212,200,0.2)';
 97:             btn.style.color = 'var(--soft-sage-dark)';
 98:         } else {
 99:             btn.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(201,113,75,0.2)';
100:             btn.style.color = 'var(--bold-accent)';
101:         }
102:     }
103: }
104: </script>
105: {% endblock %}

 87: <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/floor_map.js') }}"></script>
 88: <script>
 89:     function switchTab(view) {
 90:         document.getElementById('view-grid').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'grid');
 91:         document.getElementById('view-floor').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'floor');
 92:         document.getElementById('tab-grid').className = view === 'grid'
 93:             ? 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg bg-orange-500 text-white transition-colors'
 94:             : 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors';
 95:         document.getElementById('tab-floor').className = view === 'floor'
 96:             ? 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg bg-orange-500 text-white transition-colors'
 97:             : 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors';
 98:         if (view === 'floor') initFloor();
 99:     }
100:     let floorInitialized = false;
101:     function initFloor() {
102:         if (floorInitialized) return;
103:         floorInitialized = true;
104:         const tables = {{ floor_data | tojson }};
105:         renderFloorMap('floor-canvas', tables);
106:         // Override save URL to use proper Flask route
107:         const origSave = saveFloorLayout;

439:       function toggleNotifDropdown() {

453:       function fetchNotificationCount() {
454:         fetch('/dashboard/notifications/count')
455:           .then(r => r.json())
456:           .then(data => {

458:             if (data.count > 0) {

464:           }).catch(() => {});

466:       function fetchNotifications() {
467:         fetch('/dashboard/notifications')
468:           .then(r => r.json())
469:           .then(data => {
470:             const list = document.getElementById('notif-list');
471:             if (!data.notifications || data.notifications.length === 0) {
472:               list.innerHTML = '<div class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm" style="color: var(--soft-text-light);">No new notifications</div>';
473:               return;
474:             }
475:             list.innerHTML = data.notifications.map(n => `
476:               <div class="px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors" style="background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--soft-border);" onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='var(--soft-cream)'" onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='transparent'" onclick="markNotificationRead(${n.id}, this)">
477:                 <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
478:                   <div class="w-2 h-2 mt-1.5 rounded-full shrink-0" style="background-color: var(--bold-accent);"></div>
479:                   <div class="min-w-0">
480:                     <p class="text-sm font-medium truncate" style="color: var(--bold-dark);">${n.title}</p>
481:                     ${n.body ? `<p class="text-xs mt-0.5 line-clamp-2" style="color: var(--soft-text-light);">${n.body}</p>` : ''}
482:                     <p class="text-[10px] mt-1" style="color: var(--soft-text-light);">${timeAgo(n.created_at)}</p>
483:                   </div>
484:                 </div>
485:               </div>
486:             `).join('');
487:           }).catch(() => {});
488:       }
489:       function markNotificationRead(id, el) {
490:         fetch(`/dashboard/notifications/${id}/read`, {
491:           method: 'POST',
492:           headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken }
493:         }).then(() => {
494:           if (el) el.remove();
495:           fetchNotificationCount();
496:         }).catch(() => {});
497:       }
498:       function markAllNotificationsRead() {
499:         fetch('/dashboard/notifications/read-all', {
500:           method: 'POST',
501:           headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken }
502:         }).then(() => {
503:           document.getElementById('notif-list').innerHTML = '<div class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm" style="color: var(--soft-text-light);">No new notifications</div>';
504:           document.getElementById('notif-badge').classList.add('hidden');
505:         }).catch(() => {});
506:       }
507:       function timeAgo(isoStr) {
508:         if (!isoStr) return '';
509:         const diff = (Date.now() - new Date(isoStr).getTime()) / 1000;
510:         if (diff < 60) return 'just now';
511:         if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + 'm ago';
512:         if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + 'h ago';
513:         return Math.floor(diff / 86400) + 'd ago';
514:       }
515:       // Poll notification count every 30 seconds
516:       fetchNotificationCount();
517:       setInterval(fetchNotificationCount, 30000);
518:     </script>
519:     {% block scripts %}{% endblock %}
520:   </body>
521: </html>

153:     <script>
154:         const CSRF = document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content || '';
155:         async function serveOrder(id, btn) {
156:             const res = await fetch(`/waiter/orders/${id}/served`, {
157:                 method: 'POST',
158:                 headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
159:             });
160:             const data = await res.json();
161:             if (data.success) {
162:                 btn.closest('[data-order-id]')?.remove();
163:             } else {
164:                 alert(data.error);
165:             }
166:         }
167:         async function collectPayment(orderId, btn) {
168:             const res = await fetch(`/waiter/orders/${orderId}/confirm-payment`, {
169:                 method: 'POST',
170:                 headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
171:             });
172:             const data = await res.json();
173:             if (data.success) {
174:                 const card = btn.closest('[data-order-id]');
175:                 if (card) {
176:                     card.className = card.className.replace('bg-ruby-900/10 border-ruby-500/20', 'bg-emerald-900/10 border-emerald-500/20');
177:                     btn.remove();
178:                     const badgeEl = card.querySelector('[class*="bg-ruby-900/30"]');
179:                     if (badgeEl) {
180:                         badgeEl.className = badgeEl.className.replace('bg-ruby-900/30 text-ruby-400 border-ruby-500/30', 'bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30');
181:                         badgeEl.textContent = '💵 Paid';
182:                     }
183:                 }
184:             } else {
185:                 alert(data.error || 'Failed to confirm payment');
186:             }
187:         }
188:         async function closeTable(tableId, btn) {
189:             if (!confirm('Close this table and mark it as free?')) return;
190:             const res = await fetch(`/waiter/tables/${tableId}/close`, {
191:                 method: 'POST',
192:                 headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
193:             });
194:             const data = await res.json();
195:             if (data.success) {
196:                 location.reload();
197:             } else {
198:                 alert(data.error || 'Failed to close table');
199:             }
200:         }
201:         function updateCallBadge(tableId, delta) {
202:             const card = document.querySelector(`[data-table-id="${tableId}"]`);
203:             if (!card) return;
204:             let badge = card.querySelector('.call-badge');
205:             if (badge) {
206:                 const current = parseInt(badge.textContent.trim()) || 0;
207:                 const next = current + delta;
208:                 if (next <= 0) {
209:                     badge.remove();
210:                 } else {
211:                     badge.textContent = next;
212:                 }
213:             } else if (delta > 0) {
214:                 badge = document.createElement('span');
215:                 badge.className = 'absolute -top-3 -right-3 bg-ruby-600 border border-ruby-400 text-cream-50 text-[10px] font-bold w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(225,29,72,0.4)] z-10 call-badge';
216:                 badge.textContent = delta;
217:                 card.appendChild(badge);
218:             }
219:         }
220:         // Connect via WebSocket (instant calls, no polling)
221:         connectAsWaiter("{{ restaurant.id }}", "{{ current_user.id }}");
222:         onEvent('waiter_call', function (data) {
223:             showWaiterCall(data);
224:             // Increment badge on the table card
225:             updateCallBadge(data.table_id, 1);
226:         });
227:         onEvent('order_ready', function (data) {
228:             playSound('order_ready');
229:             // Inject the ready order card into the correct table
230:             const container = document.getElementById('orders-table-' + data.table_id);
231:             if (container) {
232:                 const card = document.createElement('div');
233:                 card.className = 'bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-500/30 p-3 flex flex-col gap-2';
234:                 card.dataset.orderId = data.order_id;
235:                 card.innerHTML = `
236:                     <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-emerald-500/20 pb-1.5">
237:                         <span class="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">#${(data.order_number || '').replace('#','')}</span>
238:                         <span class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-emerald-300">Ready</span>
239:                     </div>
240:                     <button onclick="serveOrder('${data.order_id}', this)"
241:                             class="w-full text-center bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/40 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/50 py-2 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors mt-1">
242:                         Serve Order →
243:                     </button>`;
244:                 container.appendChild(card);
245:             } else {
246:                 // Table not on screen — full reload to pick it up
247:                 location.reload();
248:             }
249:         });
250:         onEvent('table_status_change', function (data) {
251:             // Reload when a table status changes (e.g. freed)
252:             location.reload();
253:         });
254:     </script>
255: </body>
256: </html>

File: app/utils/decorators.py

  1: """Access-control decorators for role and restaurant enforcement."""
  2: import functools
  3: from datetime import datetime, timezone
  4: from flask import abort, flash, g, redirect, request, url_for
  5: from flask_login import current_user
  6: from app.models.user import User, StaffUser
  7: def role_required(*roles: str):
  8:     """Restrict a route to specific user/staff roles.
  9:     Super admins bypass role checks automatically.
 10:     Args:
 11:         *roles: Allowed role strings (e.g. 'cashier', 'owner').
 12:     Usage::
 13:         @role_required('cashier', 'owner')
 14:         def cashier_dashboard():
 15:             ...
 16:     """
 17:     def decorator(f):
 18:         @functools.wraps(f)
 19:         def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
 20:             if not current_user.is_authenticated:
 21:                 abort(401)
 22:             if isinstance(current_user, User):
 23:                 if current_user.role == 'super_admin' or current_user.role in roles:
 24:                     return f(*args, **kwargs)
 25:             elif isinstance(current_user, StaffUser):
 26:                 if current_user.role in roles:
 27:                     return f(*args, **kwargs)
 28:             abort(403)
 29:         return decorated_function
 30:     return decorator
 31: def restaurant_required(f):
 32:     """Ensure the current user is associated with a restaurant.
 33:     Loads the restaurant and stores it in ``g.restaurant``.
 34:     Aborts with 404 if no restaurant is found.
 35:     """
 36:     @functools.wraps(f)
 37:     def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
 38:         if not current_user.is_authenticated:
 39:             abort(401)
 40:         if isinstance(current_user, User):
 41:             restaurant = current_user.restaurants[0] if current_user.restaurants else None
 42:             if restaurant is None:
 43:                 abort(404, description='No restaurant found')
 44:         elif isinstance(current_user, StaffUser):
 45:             restaurant = current_user.restaurant
 46:         else:
 47:             abort(403)
 48:         g.restaurant = restaurant
 49:         # Check subscription expiry
 50:         sub = restaurant.subscription
 51:         g.subscription_expired = False
 52:         g.subscription_days_left = None
 53:         if sub and sub.expires_at:
 54:             now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 55:             expires_at = sub.expires_at
 56:             if expires_at.tzinfo is None:
 57:                 expires_at = expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
 58:             else:
 59:                 expires_at = expires_at.astimezone(timezone.utc)
 60:             if expires_at < now:
 61:                 sub.is_active = False
 62:                 g.subscription_expired = True
 63:             else:
 64:                 days_left = (expires_at - now).days
 65:                 if days_left <= 7:
 66:                     g.subscription_days_left = days_left
 67:         else:
 68:             g.subscription_expired = False
 69:         return f(*args, **kwargs)
 70:     return decorated_function
 71: def payment_required(f):
 72:     """Ensure the restaurant has completed initial payment/plan setup.
 73:     Redirects to onboarding if payment hasn't been completed.
 74:     """
 75:     @functools.wraps(f)
 76:     def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
 77:         if not current_user.is_authenticated or not isinstance(current_user, User):
 78:             abort(401)
 79:         if current_user.role == 'super_admin':
 80:             return f(*args, **kwargs)
 81:         restaurant = current_user.restaurants[0] if current_user.restaurants else None
 82:         if not restaurant:
 83:             abort(404, description='No restaurant found')
 84:         sub = restaurant.subscription
 85:         if not sub or not sub.payment_completed:
 86:             return redirect(url_for('onboarding.plans', next=request.url))
 87:         return f(*args, **kwargs)
 88:     return decorated_function
 89: def super_admin_required(f):
 90:     """Restrict a route to super admin users only."""
 91:     @functools.wraps(f)
 92:     def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
 93:         if (
 94:             not current_user.is_authenticated
 95:             or not isinstance(current_user, User)
 96:             or current_user.role != 'super_admin'
 97:         ):
 98:             abort(403)
 99:         return f(*args, **kwargs)
100:     return decorated_function
